result.final_text:
## What this letter says
Your CT scan showed a small spot (nodule) on your right lung.
It measures 4 mm.
The letter says this is very small.
It says most nodules of this size are not cancer.

## What you need to do
1. The hospital would like to repeat the CT scan in 12 months. This is to check that the nodule has not changed.
2. The hospital will send you the appointment.

## Dates and medicines
- Date of your CT scan: the letter says 10/09/2026. It is not clear if this is 10 September 2026 or 9 October 2026.
- Repeat CT scan: in 12 months. The exact date is not given yet.
- Medicines: the letter does not list any medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What is a nodule?
- What date was my CT scan?
- When will I get the appointment for the repeat scan?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
